does: Makes a StartLoading state from a progress total and one video name: an invalid name gives an empty playlist; a valid one gives a playlist of one entry named after the video and holding that one name (eoc::GameOverPlaylistQueue).

evidence.says: same shape as macOS ecl::GameStateStartLoading::MakeSimple (bg3_macos_x64+0x358C0C0): allocates 0x40 bytes and calls code:ecl::GameStateStartLoading::GameStateStartLoading with an empty queue, or builds a queue of {name, 1} and [name] first; called by code:ecl::EocClient::Load with (2, EoCFS::strSplashLogoLarian)

new game from the main menu (GK.Gui.NewGame twice) on build v34-gatekit: a client probe saw it called once, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x1FEE570; the state it made had progress total 4 and 0 playlist entries
